name: OpenCode

model.note: OpenCode model ids are provider-qualified (anthropic/claude-…); no tier naming to map, so only an explicit per-harness pin is emitted.

notes: Current docs put project agents in .opencode/agents/ and gate tools with a `permission` map (allow/ask/deny) rather than the legacy `tools` booleans — so read-only is expressed as `edit: deny`, with bash left allowed because these roles need git diff. Older OpenCode versions read the singular .opencode/agent/; if yours does, override this entry's `dir` in .waypost/harnesses/opencode.json. A front end over OpenCode is not a separate entry: OpenWork, the open-source Cowork alternative, is a desktop UI driving OpenCode and reading this same .opencode/ config, so installing for `opencode` covers it. Live 2026-09-04 (1.18.25, headless `opencode run --pure` from a throwaway project): `waypost brief` and `waypost next` ran through its bash tool with permissions auto-allowed; the full loop (story, commit, sessions, leases, doctor) did not complete headless — two runs stalled after `init` without creating a session — so the entry stays documented until an interactive session runs the runbook. Found on the way: started from inside a Claude Code session it inherited CLAUDECODE and recorded itself as claude, fixed by detecting the harness from its process first.
